name: clauderail
description: Opinionated Claude Code starter pack: CLAUDE.md, agents, commands, skills, hooks, and MCP config. Install everything with /setupclauderail or pick individual agents.

plugins.name: setupclauderail
plugins.description: Bootstrap clauderail in any project: agents, commands, skills, hooks, rules, and CLAUDE.md installed in one command.

plugins.name: code-reviewer
plugins.description: Reviews code for real bugs: logic errors, race conditions, unhandled edge cases. Skips style nitpicks.

plugins.name: debugger
plugins.description: Systematic bug isolation: reproduce, trace root cause, fix, add regression test.

plugins.name: dependency-auditor
plugins.description: Audits dependencies for outdated packages, known CVEs, and unused imports.

plugins.name: docs-writer
plugins.description: Writes and updates documentation from source code. Accurate, no hallucinated APIs.

plugins.name: planner
plugins.description: Breaks complex tasks into ordered, dependency-aware implementation steps.

plugins.name: refactorer
plugins.description: Safe refactoring with tests as a safety net. Never mixes refactoring with behavior changes.

plugins.name: security-auditor
plugins.description: OWASP-style review: injection, auth flaws, data exposure, weak crypto. Severity-ranked.

plugins.name: test-engineer
plugins.description: Writes comprehensive tests covering happy path, edge cases, errors, and concurrency.
